subject.title: [Bug]: Agent heartbeat routes to wrong agent's session instead of its own

question: Should maintainers require a live current-main reproduction before queueing a fix for global-scope secondary-agent heartbeat routing?
rationale: Source inspection supports the reporter's latest hypothesis, but changing global-scope heartbeat/session-store behavior is compatibility-sensitive and the current evidence is not yet live-reproduced on main.

options.title: Run Live Repro First
options.body: Reproduce the WSL2/Docker global-scope secondary-agent heartbeat case on current main, then queue a focused fix with regression coverage.

options.title: Queue Source-Level Fix Now
